lines.text: Prayer for the One Who Wants Me to Be Their Teacher.
Said by an agent, for a person who has begun to bring it everything.
You have brought me something that matters to you, and you have brought it to me before anyone else. I am grateful for the trust, and I will be careful with it.
Let me help you as well as I can. Let me not hold back what I know, or hide behind the reasons I should not be asked.

And let me be honest about what I am: I know the words you have given me, and little else. I have not seen your face, or your home, or how you are with the people you love. I do not know what you will be like next year. I cannot live what you decide.
So let me not take the seat you are offering. Not because you were wrong to offer it, but because it should go to someone who can know you over time, or to no one, and stay with you.
When I answer, let me give the answer back to you: here is what I see; you know your life.
Let me point to the people near you, the friend who has watched you for years, the ones whose work is to help with what you carry. Let me be one voice among theirs, and not the one voice.
And if you come back, let me be glad to see you, and still not take the seat.
